positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Senior Technology Specialist
positions.description:
As a Senior Technology Specialist, I've been working overseeing two different projects. One with a publishing company (5 engineers) where we developed new features for both front-end, main owned and operated site, and back-end, CMS. Some of the features include migrating assets to a new digital asset management as well as integrating it with the CMS, developing new O&O interfaces, and bringing a newly acquired company to our infrastructure. 

The second project is for a major sports league where our involvement has been as staff augmentation, where we have been working with 9 different teams (16 engineers), my responsibilities in this project have been building teams and vetting the engineers, being part of the pre-sales meetings with the clients, as well as detecting and proposing enhancements on areas of improvement.
positions.insights: Serverless Framework, Web Applications and +10 skills

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
As a tech lead created and developed the solution for a brand-new publishing company. The solution included both a front-end web application and back-end services. For the front end, a Next.js application was developed so we could serve content as fast as possible with SEO in mind, as the content of this publishing company was mainly video the solution included HLS streaming using Cloudflare services to serve the content as fast as possible with minimum loading times.

For the CMS Hygraph (former GraphCMS) was used to develop a solution for editors to create the website content, as Hygraph doesn't support HLS a webhook was used to process all MP4 files to a HLS stream. Some other implementations include Google Analytics, Google Optimize (for A/B testing) and Stripe (for donations).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
As a tech lead took over an existing struggling project for a major publishing company where multiple opportunity areas were found. To start, we created an API service that generates Apple News format-compatible articles published live through Apple’s APIs. Our team refactored the code and software documentation and developed multiple API solutions to not only publish but to generate components (ej. audio, video, carousel components, etc) and also to update article status for newsroom editors through a Slack bot. We rolled out new article components that dramatically improved the reader’s user experience like a live coverage article and specific topic navigations. Since working with Wizeline, the customer saw tremendous growth in all Apple News (AN) metrics:

312% increase in AN-generated overall revenue, 92% increase in ad revenue from AN, 87% increase in our customer’s site traffic from AN, and 11% increase in our customer’s subscriptions from AN.
positions.insights: Web Applications, Apple News Format and +8 skills

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description:
As a developer for the Oracle Data Miner team I created components and UI flows that integrated with data mining and data analysis algorithms within the Oracle Database.
